_about: Ready summaries for freshers (the builder's Summary step, 'Pick a ready summary'). Edit the texts here; no code change is needed. heading_te / heading_hi NEED NATIVE REVIEW. tags: tech, data, business, nontech. roles: words that put a card first when the person's headline mentions them. personalize (optional): 'find' is replaced, on tap, by the person's own skills or languages when they added any; join: oxford ('A, B, and C'), and ('A, B and C') or comma ('A, B'); count: how many skills at most.

summaries.heading: Best Overall Resume Summary
summaries.text: Motivated and detail-oriented graduate with a strong willingness to learn, adapt, and contribute to organizational success. Possess good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Eager to apply academic knowledge, develop professional expertise, and contribute to business growth.

summaries.heading: Software Developer / IT Fresher
summaries.text: Aspiring software developer with a strong foundation in programming fundamentals, logical thinking, and problem-solving. Eager to apply technical knowledge to real-world projects, learn modern technologies, and contribute to building efficient, scalable, and reliable software solutions.

summaries.heading: Data Analyst Fresher
summaries.text: Detail-oriented graduate with an interest in data analytics, statistical analysis, and data-driven decision-making. Familiar with data analysis concepts and eager to develop practical skills in Excel, SQL, Python, and data visualization tools to transform raw data into meaningful business insights.

personalize.find: Excel, SQL, Python, and data visualization tools

summaries.heading: Data Science / AI Fresher
summaries.text: Aspiring Data Science and AI professional with a foundation in analytical thinking, statistics, and problem-solving. Eager to apply knowledge of Python, SQL, machine learning, and data visualization to real-world challenges while continuously developing technical expertise and delivering data-driven solutions.

personalize.find: Python, SQL, machine learning, and data visualization

summaries.heading: Electronics and Communication Engineering Fresher
summaries.text: Recent Electronics and Communication Engineering graduate with a strong interest in technology, troubleshooting, and problem-solving. Eager to apply engineering fundamentals, analytical abilities, and technical knowledge to practical projects while contributing to team objectives and continuous improvement.

summaries.heading: Non-Technical / Any Graduate Fresher
summaries.text: Enthusiastic and responsible graduate seeking an entry-level opportunity to begin a professional career. Strong willingness to learn new skills, take ownership of responsibilities, and work effectively with diverse teams. Committed to maintaining a positive attitude, meeting organizational goals, and growing through continuous learning.

summaries.heading: HR / Recruitment Fresher
summaries.text: People-oriented graduate with an interest in human resources, talent acquisition, and employee engagement. Possess strong organizational abilities, interpersonal skills, and a willingness to learn recruitment processes, candidate screening, and HR operations while supporting effective workforce management.

summaries.heading: Business Analyst Fresher
summaries.text: Analytical and solution-oriented graduate interested in business analysis, process improvement, and data-driven decision-making. Eager to develop skills in requirements gathering, documentation, Excel, SQL, and stakeholder communication to help organizations identify problems and improve business outcomes.

summaries.heading: Sales and Marketing Fresher
summaries.text: Proactive and goal-oriented graduate with an interest in sales, marketing, customer engagement, and business development. Eager to apply communication, research, and relationship-building skills to understand customer needs, support marketing initiatives, and contribute to revenue growth.

summaries.heading: Finance / Accounts Fresher
summaries.text: Detail-oriented graduate interested in finance, accounting, and financial analysis. Eager to apply numerical, organizational, and analytical skills to financial reporting, account reconciliation, and record management while developing practical knowledge of accounting principles and financial tools.

summaries.heading: General Fresher (no course mentioned)
summaries.text: Recent graduate who learns new tools quickly and works well with people. Comfortable with MS Office, email and online research, and communicates clearly in English and Hindi. Looking for an entry-level role to build practical skills and grow with the team.

summaries.heading: Skills and Project Fresher (no course mentioned)

summaries.text: Fresher with hands-on practice in Excel, data entry and report preparation through college projects and short online courses. Careful with details and meets deadlines. Looking for a first job where these skills can support daily operations.
